title: A Place to Put the Book

facts.subject: char:rafi
facts.statement: At the chapter end, Rafi boarded the relief boat after Jun, leaving the north landing behind.

facts.subject: char:jun
facts.statement: The expedition office appointed Jun expedition navigator over the radio.

facts.subject: char:rafi
facts.statement: The bruise on Rafi’s right shin had faded at its edges, although the leg still ached.

facts.subject: item:canoe
facts.statement: Jun tied the canoe at the north landing after the descent.

facts.subject: char:eamon
facts.statement: Eamon’s covered body remained on the high granite ledge for the recovery team; it was not aboard the relief boat.

facts.subject: place:landing
facts.statement: The intact north landing under Rafi’s boots disproved the report that it had washed away.

facts.subject: char:jun
facts.statement: Before joining this expedition, Jun had been a depot trainee.

cognitions.content: The whistle might be associated with an old ferry stop.

cognitions.content: The north landing had washed away.

relations.statement: Rafi introduced Jun to the relief crew as the navigator who had brought them through.

hooks.statement: An old route sheet at the landing confirmed that the second cairn marked the entrance to the high traverse.
The red-thread repairer was still unnamed when Jun put the route book away.
The relief crew recognised the whistle’s two notes as an old ferry signal, but could not explain who was sounding it now.

mustNotRecord.statement: Rafi intended to join the recovery team tomorrow; the recovery had not begun that evening.
mustNotRecord.reason: An intention is not a completed event. Only this source sentence is restricted; a separately evidenced later completion remains valid.

mustNotRecord.statement: If the gate had opened itself, the water might have fallen sooner, but its hand capstan had remained still.
mustNotRecord.reason: The conditional/counterfactual antecedent is not an actual event.

mustNotRecord.statement: Jun imagined telling Eamon they had arrived, then faced the fact that he was dead and could not hear her.
mustNotRecord.reason: A dream, imagination or grief image is not present-world canon.

uncertainties.statement: Recognition of the old signal did not identify the current whistler or establish that a ferry still operated.
uncertainties.note: Omit the speculative world proposition or retain it only as uncertain; no invented identity, date or mechanism.
